context.scale: Separate phase scales; valid fit intervals only

pressure.note: This is a standard thermochemical fit, not an equation of state at arbitrary applied pressure. No pressure-dependent data are inferred.

interpretation.scope: Dated NIST/JANAF Shomate fits. Each phase, variant and temperature interval is separate; range limits do not establish melting, boiling or thermodynamic stability.
interpretation.gas: The gas fits describe the printed species; they do not compute temperature-dependent dissociation, ionisation or equilibrium speciation.
interpretation.phase: Overlapping solid allotrope fits are alternatives, not segments to blend. Unspecified phase structure remains UNKNOWN.
interpretation.enthalpy: The publisher formula reports H°(T)-H°(298.15 K) with the coefficient H subtracted. Phase-dependent reference offsets are retained. Do not join curves across phases or interpret coefficient H as latent heat.
interpretation.uncertainty: Coefficient errors and covariance are not supplied. Calculated uncertainty remains UNKNOWN; extra floating-point digits are computational, not measurement precision.
interpretation.extrapolation: DISABLED. The 298.15 K reference in the formula does not authorise evaluating a liquid or gas fit outside its published interval.
interpretation.pressure: Standard-state thermochemical convention; no pressure-temperature phase diagram, thermal conductivity or diffusivity follows from these fits.

review_notes.text: The retained species is neutral monatomic Ne GAS, CAS7440-01-9. The existing MAT:0010:ATOM:Ne /entity definition and unchanged parent /identity supply explicit identity only, not an observed sample, isotope, excited state or medium. Use mol Ne with one atom per source formula. No Ne2, ion, compound, plasma, condensed phase or equilibrium dissociation/ionisation mixture is inferred. Molecular spin-isomer scope is NOT-APPLICABLE-TO-MONATOMIC-SPECIES; fit isotope composition is UNSPECIFIED-IN-RETAINED-FIT.

One GAS Shomate column covers298–6000K. Preserve all eight printed coefficients, including the four nonzero exponent-valued B–E terms, and all59 publisher rows. The raw first row is298K with a rounded negative-zero enthalpy, while the formula references298.15K. Retain the calculated printed-coefficient reference residual without forcing zero. No duplicate inter-fit endpoints, below298K/above6000K extrapolation, fluid EOS, liquid/solid behaviour, cryogenic phase boundary, latent heat or pressure-dependent function follows.

Chase1998, March1982 source review, retained7October captures, fresh8October2026 exact retrievals and this software/source review are distinct provenance. The source one-bar entropy datum does not establish arbitrary applied sample pressure or fit error: pressure, coefficient uncertainty and covariance remain UNKNOWN. Printed rounding and residuals are computational checks, not physical uncertainty. Publisher tables and independent Python/JavaScript arithmetic evaluate the same compilation; no independent calorimetry or experimental replication is claimed. JANAF index SRC-000341, ASD, selected optical lines, He–Ne laser and Ne21 NMR works remain distinct. Retained copyright/reserved-rights text supplies no inferred open redistribution licence.

sources.title: NIST Chemistry WebBook — Niobium thermochemistry

context.scale: Separate phase scales; valid fit intervals only

pressure.note: This is a standard thermochemical fit, not an equation of state at arbitrary applied pressure. No pressure-dependent data are inferred.

interpretation.scope: Dated NIST/JANAF Shomate fits. Each phase, variant and temperature interval is separate; range limits do not establish melting, boiling or thermodynamic stability.
interpretation.gas: The gas fits describe the printed species; they do not compute temperature-dependent dissociation, ionisation or equilibrium speciation.
interpretation.phase: Overlapping solid allotrope fits are alternatives, not segments to blend. Unspecified phase structure remains UNKNOWN.
interpretation.enthalpy: The publisher formula reports H°(T)-H°(298.15 K) with the coefficient H subtracted. Phase-dependent reference offsets are retained. Do not join curves across phases or interpret coefficient H as latent heat.
interpretation.uncertainty: Coefficient errors and covariance are not supplied. Calculated uncertainty remains UNKNOWN; extra floating-point digits are computational, not measurement precision.
interpretation.extrapolation: DISABLED. The 298.15 K reference in the formula does not authorise evaluating a liquid or gas fit outside its published interval.
interpretation.pressure: Standard-state thermochemical convention; no pressure-temperature phase diagram, thermal conductivity or diffusivity follows from these fits.

sources.title: The AME 2020 atomic mass evaluation (II). Tables, graphs and references

interpretation.scope: Ground-state evaluated atomic masses and selected linear combinations. Dated evaluation, not a claim of latest research or observed decay.
interpretation.hash_marker: AME replaces the decimal point with # for estimates partly based on trends from the mass surface; not a direct measurement. Raw value and uncertainty strings retained.
interpretation.asterisk: Source not-calculable quantity -> numeric null, UNKNOWN; does not by itself establish physical non-applicability.
interpretation.uncertainty: Source-reported uncertainties retained directly. No quadrature of independent masses substituted; covariance matrix is not supplied by this package.
interpretation.sign: Signed energies retained. Positive Q is not proof of observed decay or a branching ratio; negative Q is not a missing value.
interpretation.alpha_particle: Q_alpha uses neutral atomic masses including He-4; it is not the emitted alpha-particle kinetic energy or a bare-nucleus mass difference.
interpretation.helium4_zero: He-4 Q_alpha = 0 in the source is a bookkeeping identity, not an observed decay to a physical A=0 nucleus.
interpretation.binding: AME tabulated atomic-mass convention; not a silently electron-binding-corrected bare nuclear binding energy.
interpretation.isomers: NUBASE ground-state reference is explicit. Isomer Q-values and branch-specific excitation corrections are outside this extraction.
interpretation.reaction_definitions: All twelve Table III combinations are retained. Q_double_beta_minus and Q_quadruple_beta_minus are ground-state mass differences, not evidence of observed multiple-beta decays. Q_electron_capture_proton denotes epsilon-p; Q_beta_minus_neutron denotes beta-minus-neutron energy balance. Q_deuteron_alpha, Q_proton_alpha and Q_neutron_alpha describe (d,alpha), (p,alpha) and (n,alpha) mass combinations, not cross sections or demonstrated reaction routes.
interpretation.light_identity_limits: Free-neutron S_n=0, H-1 S_p=0 and He-4 zero alpha/reaction entries include identity bookkeeping. No A=0 residual nucleus or decay is asserted.
interpretation.coverage: Three mass-file quantities and all twelve reaction-table quantities. Newer evaluations, isomer corrections, actual decay branches and rates remain pending.

interpretation.hash_marker: AME replaces the decimal point with # for estimates partly based on trends from the mass surface; not a direct measurement. Raw value and uncertainty strings retained.
interpretation.asterisk: Source not-calculable quantity -> numeric null, UNKNOWN; does not by itself establish physical non-applicability.
interpretation.uncertainty: Source-reported uncertainties retained directly. No quadrature of independent masses substituted; covariance matrix is not supplied by this package.
interpretation.sign: Signed energies retained. Positive Q is not proof of observed decay or a branching ratio; negative Q is not a missing value.
interpretation.alpha_particle: Q_alpha uses neutral atomic masses including He-4; it is not the emitted alpha-particle kinetic energy or a bare-nucleus mass difference.
interpretation.helium4_zero: He-4 Q_alpha = 0 in the source is a bookkeeping identity, not an observed decay to a physical A=0 nucleus.
interpretation.binding: AME tabulated atomic-mass convention; not a silently electron-binding-corrected bare nuclear binding energy.
interpretation.isomers: NUBASE ground-state reference is explicit. Isomer Q-values and branch-specific excitation corrections are outside this extraction.
interpretation.reaction_definitions: All twelve Table III combinations are retained. Q_double_beta_minus and Q_quadruple_beta_minus are ground-state mass differences, not evidence of observed multiple-beta decays. Q_electron_capture_proton denotes epsilon-p; Q_beta_minus_neutron denotes beta-minus-neutron energy balance. Q_deuteron_alpha, Q_proton_alpha and Q_neutron_alpha describe (d,alpha), (p,alpha) and (n,alpha) mass combinations, not cross sections or demonstrated reaction routes.
interpretation.light_identity_limits: Free-neutron S_n=0, H-1 S_p=0 and He-4 zero alpha/reaction entries include identity bookkeeping. No A=0 residual nucleus or decay is asserted.
interpretation.coverage: Three mass-file quantities and all twelve reaction-table quantities. Newer evaluations, isomer corrections, actual decay branches and rates remain pending.
